thread:
ana: heads-up — invoice-preview shows a ~+700 token jump for several routes after last night's model swap. only affected routes that route-to-quantized. noticed at 02:05 UTC.
cole: interesting. did the swap change tokenization (byte-pair vocab) or just model binary?
ana: it's a swap from model-v1-small -> model-v2-quant (same architecture but different tokenizer config). rollout note said 'compatible vocab' but apparently not.
peter: token counts are upstream of billing; if tokenizer changed, the runtime emits different tokenization lengths which flow into metering. but invoice-preview should reflect that if it's real. could this be a preview-only mismatch?
tiay: small correction: it's not preview-only — downstream ledger shows extra tokens for a subset of tenants that hit routing policy A (route->quantized). the delta is exactly the tokenization delta.
cole: logs?
ana: pasted snippet:
```
2025-02-12T02:04:59Z INFO runtime start req=Z77 route=quantized model=model-v2-quant tokenizer=bpv2
2025-02-12T02:05:01Z INFO runtime tokens.emitted req=Z77 tokens=892
2025-02-12T02:05:01Z INFO meter persist req=Z77 tokens=892 persisted=true
```
vs earlier for same prompt:
```
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z INFO runtime start req=Y55 route=baseline model=model-v1-small tokenizer=bpv1
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z INFO runtime tokens.emitted req=Y55 tokens=168
```
cole: wow that's a massive difference — likely tokenizer merges fewer subtokens in bpv2. billing expects model swaps to keep tokenization semantics stable unless there's a documented delta.
peter: two attack vectors: 1) we surface tokenizer changes in the model catalog and annotate previews/console to show expected token multiplier; 2) add a routing policy flag that opts a tenant into 'token-stable' models only (i.e., do not route them to models with incompatible tokenization).
tiay: immediate mitigation: add a transient metric on the console per-tenant: `metering.token_multiplier` = emitted_tokens / baseline_tokens using a small sample prompt set. flag tenants > 2x and send notice. also rollback the swap for route=quantized until we add opt-in.
cole: +1 on opt-in. we should also update the invoice-preview to annotate which model and tokenizer produced the token counts (so CS can explain to customers).
ana: open PR #9054 to add tokenizer metadata to meter events: include fields `model` and `tokenizer` in the metering envelope (non-sensitive). small change in runtime finalizer.
peter: careful — adding fields changes event schema; aggregator needs an incremental schema migration. let's include them as optional strings and version the schema (v2). aggregator should continue to accept v1 envelopes gracefully.
tiay: I'll draft aggregator change: accept optional tokenizer, and compute `tokenization_profile` used by UI. also add dashboard card that plots token_ratio per route over time.
ana: rolling back quantized route on canary now. deploying to canary 2% at 02:30.
billing-bot: NOTICE invoice-preview anomaly detected for routes routing->quantized; affected tenants: k9x, r2m, z3s.
cole: follow-up: add a short runbook entry under Console->Billing called "Model Tokenization Mismatch" detailing how to detect, mitigate (rollback route or opt tenant out) and reconcile invoices if needed.
tiay: will do. also scheduling a small reconcile job to normalize invoices for the three tenants after rollback if necessary.
peter: long-term: model catalog should include a tokenization_compatibility score and a recommended preview multiplier to help customers understand cost expectations. file a product ticket.
ana: created PR #9054 (runtime) and issue ENG-1172 for catalog metadata. canary looks clear so far. closing once staged rolled. :white_check_mark:
